metadata.title: Macroscopic scalar curvature bounds on graphs
metadata.abstract: We establish sharp lower bounds for the lengths of balls in the universal covers of finite metric graphs. For a finite connected $d$-regular graph, with $d \geq 3$ and average edge length at most one, we show that, at every radius, the average length of balls centered at a vertex of the universal cover is at least that of a ball of the same radius in the equilateral $d$-regular tree. We extend this comparison to arbitrary finite connected graphs whose total length does not exceed that of an equilateral trivalent graph with the same cyclomatic number. In particular, we show that the maximal length of a ball centered at a vertex of the universal cover is bounded below by that of a ball of the same radius in the equilateral trivalent tree. This answers a question of the first author. Furthermore, equality at an integer radius forces all edges to have unit length in the regular case and, in the general case, forces the graph to be an equilateral trivalent graph after suppressing vertices of degree two. In contrast, rigidity fails at every noninteger radius.

analysis.progressType: 度量图万有覆盖的宏观球比较
analysis.workSummary: 有限连通d正则图、d≥3、平均边长≤1时，每个半径上万有覆盖顶点球的平均长度至少等边d正则树的同半径球长度。推广到总长不超过同cyclomatic number等边三价图的任意有限连通图，得到最大顶点球长的三价树下界；整数半径等号强制相应等边结构，而每个非整数半径刚性都失效。
techniques: 度量图边长平均与总长归一化
analysis.breakthrough: 给出锐利宏观标量曲率式比较，并揭示离散尺度对刚性的决定作用。
analysis.limitations: 正则图是平均球长比较，一般图是最大球长比较；等号刚性只在整数半径，不能扩大到所有实半径或逐顶点同一下界。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
